prompt_en: Photorealistic cinematic special-warfare survival scene featuring the same unmistakably adult woman from the original reference portrait as a Republic of Korea special-warfare operator. Inside the tilted, torn-open wreckage of a recently crashed military helicopter, a wide 16:9 landscape frame looks inward from the ruptured side door at the nearest hostile fighter's viewpoint. She crouches inside, shoulders a compact carbine, and aims directly at the nearest threat and camera, both gloved hands controlling the weapon. Multiple hostile fighters encircle the wreck, visible through the shattered windshield, opposite doorway, and rear fuselage breach. Tan dust cakes her face, hair, helmet, and plate carrier while wet black engine oil streaks her cheek, sleeves, and gloves. Preserve her long oval face, eye aperture and spacing, jaw width, nose, lips, natural skin texture, adult age, and long dark wavy hair beneath the grime. Hanging cables, drifting dust, leaking oil, sparks, and a red emergency lamp crowd the cabin. Cold daylight cuts through the openings as warm sparks edge her focused eyes and clenched jaw, creating tense cinematic military action key art.
